title: Ein jungsteinzeitlicher Schneereif vom Gurgler Eisjoch (3134 m) im Pfossental/Schnals (Südtirol)
version: Archäologisches Korrespondenzblatt 46(4), pp. 445–463. DOI 10.11588/ak.2016.4.74815. Full original article text as displayed by Academia.edu; journal online issue posted in 2020.
lineage: The version read reproduces the original report. The journal abstract and museum description summarize the same artefact. Two measurements from separate laboratories concern the same physical object.

passages.note: The authors identify birch wood, describe the hoop and crossing split branches, and distinguish surviving pieces and attachment traces from a reconstructed original arrangement. They describe signs of wear on the hoop and interpret use as a snowshoe.

passages.locator: p. 451, radiocarbon paragraph; p. 459, nn. 13–14; p. 462, summary
passages.note: The article reports 5013 ± 23 BP, with a stated 2σ component 3811–3710 BCE (63%), and 4958 ± 45 BP, with a stated 2σ component 3810–3640 BCE (88.1%). It summarises the object's Late Neolithic date as 3800–3700 BCE. Laboratory identifiers in nn. 13 and 14 are D37/15-DSH7145_W and LTL16459A. The measurements date wood.
